```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Republicans will promote policies that encourage workers to save.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support the President's proposal to create a new Lifetime Savings Account (LSA) so workers can save for a variety of needs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support consolidating the three types of current law IRAs into a single Retirement Savings Account (RSA).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support consolidating numerous employer-based retirement plans into a single Employer Retirement Savings Account (ERSA).",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These account options will promote personal saving, which opens up more opportunities for the saver and increases private capital that is available to entrepreneurs for investing, growing the economy, and creating jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans remain committed to the principles the President outlined for Social Security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Anyone now receiving Social Security, or close to being eligible for it, is guaranteed that their benefits will not be cut and their taxes will not be raised.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Social Security is a promise made by the United States to its citizens and Republicans will keep that promise.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Key changes to Social Security should merit bipartisan agreement so all improvements are a win for the American people rather than a political victory for any one party.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
